_comment: Physical dimensions of every column, as flat unit strings. Symbols: kg m s K A mol cd N Pa J W, joined with * and /, optional integer powers with ^. Use "1" for a dimensionless quantity. These drive the Buckingham-Pi reduction; a wrong unit yields a confidently meaningless group, so they are declared rather than inferred.

_notes.u_inf: Base-10 logarithm of a groundwater Darcy velocity, therefore dimensionless as tabulated.
_notes.LCOH: Levelised cost of heat, reported per unit energy; carries no dimension within this parameter set.
_notes.LCOH_i: Levelised cost including the investment term. Exactly proportional to LCOH in this data set.
